references.text: The description of the daily burnt offering instituted at Sinai, to which Numbers 28:6 refers
The expression 'a pleasing aroma, a fire offering to the Lord' is used in the same way for the burnt offering
Description of the burnt offering as 'a pleasing aroma to the Lord' (ריח ניחח)
Regulations concerning the continual burnt offering (עלת תמיד) that was to be kept burning continuously
The Lord's revelation on Mount Sinai, where the laws of sacrifice were given
Ezekiel's prophecy about the daily burnt offering in the restored temple
The restoration of the daily burnt offering after the exile, as a continuation of the Sinai system
Daniel's prophecy that the daily offering (תמיד) would be removed
